gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Autour One runs a single flat line weight through every glyph, giving its round letters a bold, expressive punch up front. Noto Sans Nabataean does the quieter job: near cap-tall lowercase, open s curves.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-nag-munda: Noto Sans Nag Mundari carries a lowercase that rivals its capitals in height, quietly doing the reading work. Autour One is the loud one, with joins that match its strokes and a bold, expressive face.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-old-itali: Autour One outlines its letters in a steady, unshaded line, which gives the heading a bold, expressive look. Noto Sans Old Italic stays quiet beside it, keeping curve endings apart and lowercase near cap height.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-old-north: No contrast between stems and joins gives Autour One its bold swagger. Noto Sans Old North Arabian sits below it with a dense, tall lowercase band and terminals that point outward like tongs.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-old-permi: Loud and round: Autour One gives its curved letters walls that match the straight ones in weight. Noto Sans Old Permic is the friendly counterweight, its rounded forms staying open to the side.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-old-persi: Zero hairlines, all attitude: Autour One has no thinner parts in any letter, only expressive, uniform strokes. Noto Sans Old Persian keeps text light line after line, its counters breathing and its lowercase lofty.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-old-sogdi: Noto Sans Old Sogdian has a tall x-height nearly reaching cap height. Beside the hairline-free, expressive Autour One, its wide-mouthed letters stay crisp when shrunk, and that is the real draw.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-old-turki: Noto Sans Old Turkic comes in chunky and tall in the lowercase, its open-mouthed curves staying clear. Noto Sans Old Turkic handles the reading while Autour One, whose letterforms look like bent tubing, supplies the shout.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-oriya: One single weight outlines every Autour One letter. Noto Sans Oriya brings generous curve gaps and small letters almost as tall as the capitals, giving the loud heading an open-handed partner.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-osage: Autour One draws letters that read like outlines in a single width, bold at the top. But Noto Sans Osage fills the line with full bowls and sweeping curves that never close up, so text keeps moving.
